entries.mechanism: PE-US 1.767.3 has the correct 2026 $400-at-$1,000 deduction-floor parameters, but qualified_business_income_deduction.py lines 20-34 calculates the floor from total qualified_business_income plus sstb_qualified_business_income. It exposes no separate aggregate of QBI from active qualified trades or businesses. This fixture has $300,000 of QBI but an active-business QBI aggregate of zero, so section 199A(i)'s active-business minimum is inapplicable and the wage/UBIA-limited lawful result is zero; PE returns its $400 floor.
